## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why do you need it?

**Example**: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🔧 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🎨 User Experience

How would users interact with this feature?

**Example user flow:**
1. User opens app
2. User navigates to...
3. User sees...

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If you have mockups, screenshots, or examples from other apps, please share them here.

## 🌟 Benefits

Who would benefit from this feature and how?

- **Users**: [How it helps users]
- **Business**: [How it helps the project]

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## 📊 Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Can't use the app without it

- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just an idea

Which version do you think this should be in?

- [ ] v1.1 (Improvements)
- [ ] v1.2 (Analytics)

- [ ] Future consideration

Add any other context, links, or information about the feature request here.
